channel.title: IT services · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on IT services in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+2.6).

item.title: [+3] Rupee Nears Record Low Even as RBI Signals Further Tightening
item.description:
Signal: a weaker rupee. 44 reports from Bloomberg.com, Reuters, The New Indian Express and 31 more. Related: “Rupee risks more losses after post-RBI policy slide, higher oil adds to woes”. Ongoing: also reported on 2 of the previous 7 days (first 6 Oct).

IT services: strong tailwind (+3) — IT exporters earn more in rupees

Why it matters: A weaker rupee raises the cost of oil and other imports and imported inflation, but lifts IT and pharma exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee −3, Inflation outlook −1, Foreign investor flows −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Reserves drop as FCNR inflows dry, RBI dollar sales continue
item.description:
Signal: a weaker dollar. 3 reports from The Economic Times, FXStreet, شبكة تواصل الإخبارية. Related: “United States Dollar Index retreats from YTD top; holds above 102.00 | FXStreet”. Mixed: 2 reports point the other way. Turn: earlier readings (2 Oct) pointed the other way.

IT services: mild headwind (−1) — Dollar earnings worth less

Why it matters: A softer dollar eases pressure on the rupee and draws foreign money back to emerging markets.

Market gauges: Rupee +1, Foreign investor flows +1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks
